Sitting Date:25-05-1955

LEGISLATIVE ASSEMBLY (POWERS AND PRIVILEGES) BILL

"to declare the powers and privileges of the Assembly", presented by the Chief Secretary; read the First time.

LEGISLATIVE ASSEMBLY (POWERS AND PRIVILEGES) BILL

Order for Second Reading read.

The Chief Secretary (Mr Goode): Mr Speaker, Sir, I beg to move, "That the Bill be now read a Second time." This Bill concerns Assembly powers and privileges uniquely.

LABOUR BILL

"to amend the labour law", presented by the Minister for Labour; read the First time.

LABOUR BILL

Order for Second Reading read.

The Minister for Labour (Mr Lim): Mr Speaker, Sir, I beg to move, "That the Bill be now read a Second time." This Labour Bill uniquely amends overtime rules.
